ITEM 1 | Bright red strawberries, halved and quartered pieces with glossy, juicy surfaces, white-tinged cores visible on cut faces, roughly 4-5 pieces covering about 25% of the plate's left side, each piece about 2-4 cm long, sitting on the left edge of the plate | 85
ITEM 2 | Pale yellow scrambled eggs, soft and fluffy curds with moist, slightly glossy surface, clumped in a loose mound covering about 25% of the plate's right side, curd pieces about 1-2 cm, piled roughly 2 cm high | 110
ITEM 3 | Orange cubed sweet potato pieces, roughly 1.5-2 cm cubes with browned, caramelized edges and slightly dry, matte surface, scattered in a cluster in the center of the plate covering about 15% of the plate | 65
ITEM 4 | Browned meat pieces, brown-to-reddish surfaces with darker seared edges and a slightly glossy sheen, two to three chunks about 2 cm each, lying between the sweet potato and strawberries near the bottom center of the plate | 25
ITEM 5 | Small dark blue berry, glossy and round about 1 cm across, sitting at the bottom center beside the sweet potato cubes | 3
